INTEGER BOOST
💡 TIP

Quick Reminder!

Master these rules before entering the arena.

➕ ADDITION

Same signs → add and keep the sign.
Different signs → subtract absolute values and keep the sign of the larger absolute value.
−5 + 8 = 3

➖ SUBTRACTION

Change subtraction into addition of the opposite.
5 − (−2) = 5 + 2 = 7

✖️ MULTIPLICATION

Same signs = positive
Different signs = negative

➗ DIVISION

Same signs = positive
Different signs = negative
